message:
Nels, I'll ask: what does "critical literacy" mean to you, and to your students?

And yeah, I love *Newjack*. Fantastic book. I've also taught, for various courses, Wideman's brilliant *Brothers and Keepers*, portions of *Discipline and Punish*, Franklin's usefully comprehensive anthology *[Prison Writing in 20th Century America](http://andromeda.rutgers.edu/~hbf/Books/Prison20th.html)*, and Megan Foss's underappreciated essays ["Love Letters"](http://www.creativenonfiction.org/thejournal/articles/issue09/09contents.htm) and ["The Monster Between Us"](http://www.creativenonfiction.org/thejournal/articles/issue12/12foss_ai.htm).

What else is on your syllabus?
